lenses.name: Population
lenses.description: Residents per km² at the 2011 census: each district's population over its area, averaged over the districts the hex covers. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Growth 2001–2011
lenses.description: Population change from the 2001 to the 2011 census (Table A-02, on 2011 boundaries), per district. Blank where today's district was carved out of a 2011 district that was split, because the 2001 count for its part is not published. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Urban
lenses.description: Share of each district's 2011 population living in statutory or census towns. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Literacy
lenses.description: Literates as a share of people aged 7 and over, per district, at the 2011 census. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Farm workers
lenses.description: Cultivators and agricultural labourers (main and marginal) as a share of all workers, per district, at the 2011 census. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Income per person
lenses.description: Per-capita Net State Domestic Product at current prices, 2022-23 (NSO state accounts, RBI handbook). Blank for states that have not published it. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: State-wide values: every hex of a state has the same colour.

lenses.name: Poverty
lenses.description: Share of people who are multidimensionally poor, by district: NITI Aayog's National MPI (Progress Review 2023), computed from NFHS-5 (2019-21). Blank for districts created after 2017. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Business jobs
lenses.description: Non-farm jobs in establishments at the 2013 Economic Census (MoSPI, via SHRUG) per 100 people counted in the district at the 2011 census. Includes shops, workshops, offices and public services; crop farming is not counted. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Urban unemployment
lenses.description: Unemployment rate in towns and cities, usual status (adjusted), from the Periodic Labour Force Survey as published in the RBI handbook, by state. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: State-wide values: every hex of a state has the same colour.

lenses.name: Life expectancy
lenses.description: Life expectancy at birth from the Sample Registration System (RBI handbook), by state. Published for the larger states only; the others are blank. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: State-wide values: every hex of a state has the same colour.

lenses.name: Air pollution
lenses.description: Fine-particle air pollution: the annual mean surface PM2.5 estimated from satellites and a chemical transport model (van Donkelaar et al.), averaged by SHRUG over each 2011 sub-district and here over each district. India's annual standard is 40 µg/m³; the WHO guideline is 5. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Earthquakes
lenses.description: Earthquakes of magnitude 5.5 or more since 1900 (USGS catalogue) with an epicentre within 50 km of the hex centre. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: Early-20th-century records are incomplete; zero means none recorded, not no risk.

lenses.name: Strongest quake
lenses.description: The largest magnitude among M5.5+ earthquakes since 1900 within 50 km of the hex centre (USGS catalogue). Blank where none was recorded.

lenses.name: Sanitation
lenses.description: Share of people living in households that use an improved sanitation facility. From the NFHS-5 district fact sheets (2019-21); blank for districts created after 2017 or without a matching fact sheet. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Clean cooking fuel
lenses.description: Share of households cooking with clean fuel (electricity, LPG / natural gas, biogas). From the NFHS-5 district fact sheets (2019-21); blank for districts created after 2017 or without a matching fact sheet. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Women's schooling
lenses.description: Share of women aged 15-49 with 10 or more years of schooling. From the NFHS-5 district fact sheets (2019-21); blank for districts created after 2017 or without a matching fact sheet. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Health insurance
lenses.description: Share of households with any usual member covered by a health insurance or financing scheme. From the NFHS-5 district fact sheets (2019-21); blank for districts created after 2017 or without a matching fact sheet. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Child stunting
lenses.description: Share of children under 5 who are stunted (too short for their age). From the NFHS-5 district fact sheets (2019-21); blank for districts created after 2017 or without a matching fact sheet. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Child marriage
lenses.description: Share of women aged 20-24 who were married before age 18. From the NFHS-5 district fact sheets (2019-21); blank for districts created after 2017 or without a matching fact sheet. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Forest
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land covered by trees (ESA WorldCover 2021). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Farmland
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land that is cropland (ESA WorldCover 2021). WorldCover has no separate pasture class; grazed steppe counts as grassland. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Built-up
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land that is built-up (ESA WorldCover 2021): buildings, roads and other sealed surfaces. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
